source:
# Port of lib/pubid/plateau/parser.rb: PLATEAU Handbook/Technical Report
# #NN[-annex][ edition], plus Annex supplements. Japanese canonical
# edition (第X.Y版) and legacy Latin X.Y both capture the same atom.

grammar PubidPlateau version "0.1.0" {
  doc_type = ("Handbook" / "Technical Report") as type
  number = "#" (1*digit) as number
  annex = (dash / "_") (1*digit) as annex
  edition_part = "第" (1*digit "." 1*digit) as edition "版"
  edition_latin = (1*digit "." 1*digit) as edition
  edition = space (edition_part / edition_latin)
  annex_letter = upper as annex_letter
  annex_supplement = space "Annex" space annex_letter
  handbook = "PLATEAU" space doc_type space number [annex] [edition]
  technical_report = "PLATEAU" space doc_type space number [annex]
  annex_identifier = (handbook / technical_report) as base annex_supplement
  identifier = annex_identifier / handbook / technical_report
  upper = %x41-5A
  digit = %x30-39
  space = " "
  dash = "-"
  entry identifier: identifier

  test {
    accept "PLATEAU Handbook #3"
    accept "PLATEAU Technical Report #1"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
